title: Chewbacca
subtitle: The Resistance
description: When his friend, Han Solo, lost his son, Ben, and their home in the Millennium Falcon, Chewbacca the Wookiee joined back up with him to smuggle illicit goods across the stars once more. When the Resistance came calling, though, Chewbacca joined back up and helped take down Starkiller Base, even though it would cost him the life of his best friend.
